_about: Read by eye from the HUD of the first and last frame of each hardware clip. start_deg = 'X deg at start', end_deg = final 'Y deg to goal', hud_end_s = where the HUD time axis trace ends. The green dashed HUD line is the 0.4 rad (22.9 deg) threshold.

real_01.speed_note: Not real time throughout: the first ~15 s of the clip cover ~26 s on the HUD clock (about 1.75x); after that it runs at real time. Overall the 45.8 s clip covers ~56 s, so a playbackRate badge understates the true speed-up.

real_02.speed_note: Real time. Opens with ~7.5 s of a person placing the cube in the hand before the policy starts (poster taken at 10 s).
